svg.title: ETO Tracker — Workflow and review routes
svg.desc: November 2026 reference. Microsoft Entra and Admin Console gate access. ART selects TOUS or TOUK and independently includes Engineering and Production. Four routes lead to ART Final, Quote and Won or Lost. Return, decline, abandon, split, reassignment and grouped email-audit rules are explained below.
svg.text: ETO TRACKER · WORKFLOW REFERENCE
Current implementation · November 2026 · Four review routes, one shared request record
Access before workflow
Microsoft Entra sign-in → Admin Console authorizes app ETO → existing ETO role or new Role None
None: own profile only, no ETO data. Console denial/service failure blocks sign-in. App roles remain separate.
1 · Draft
Sales / ART
Intake, units, currency, attachments
Submit
2 · ART Review
Select TOUS / TOUK; include Engineering and/or Production
Confirm reviewers and schedule · First submission assigns ETO number
Assignment defaults
TOUS: Engineering + Production
TOUK: Engineering + Production
ART acceptance chooses one of four forward paths
Engineering and Production are independent options. Every route continues to ART Final Review.
Both included
Engineering Review
Production Review
Engineering only
Engineering Review
Production only
Production Review
Neither included
Complete Review advances to the next included stage. Re-Assign stays in the current stage.
3 · ART Final Review
Price + lead time calculator
Market Price / Market Lead Time / Description / Notes
Description required · Quote defaults remain editable
Generate
4 · Quoted
Sales / ART close-out
Won
Lost · reason required
Returns and lifecycle controls
ART → Draft · Engineering → ART · Production → Engineering if included, otherwise ART
ART Final → last included specialist / ART; specific Engineering return supported · Quoted → ART Final
ART may Decline at ART Review or ART Final. ART / SuperUser may Abandon; Reopen restores the prior stage.
Returns need reasons and preserve outputs / original schedule. Won, Lost and Declined are terminal.
Review output and calculated lead time
Engineering: design hours, P/N guidance, risk
Production: procurement cost/time, assembly hours, risk
Lead Time = Design + Procurement + Assembly weeks
Quote starts at ceiling(total weeks); missing values are not zero.
Assignment, due dates and splits
Same-stage Re-Assign selects a user in that department.
Schedule starts at initial ART acceptance; no reset on returns.
ART may split into 2–10 children during eligible ART Review.
Parent stays linked/read-only; explicit reviewers remain preserved.
Notifications and record integrity
Graph: ART submission → ART; confirmations → next reviewer; reassignment → new reviewer.
ART completion / Quote → Submitted by. Ten independent Admin toggles; new types start off; bulk yes/no.
Audit Trail: Stage / Details / Email. One email event groups all recipients; Graph acceptance ≠ inbox delivery.
Shared data: Azure PostgreSQL d365crm / crm.eto_* · Private file objects: App Storage · Email failures do not undo workflow.
Current-state reference; not a production acceptance certificate. Full role guards and API details are in the companion documents.
